subject.title: fix: inject only shared auth into macos dashboard

question: Should the embedded macOS Dashboard browser receive only configured shared gateway tokens, or may it reuse native/stored device tokens for parity with native clients?
rationale: Both directions have open issue/PR evidence, and the choice affects credential boundaries plus upgrade behavior for users without a shared token or password.

options.title: Use shared-token-only browser auth
options.body: Land a rebased version of this PR after it updates all Dashboard injection paths, fixes the test helper, and proves the macOS behavior.

options.title: Preserve native-token parity
options.body: Close or pause this PR and continue with the sibling parity PR after it proves native/operator token injection is an intended browser path.

options.title: Keep both open for owner review
options.body: Leave both draft PRs paused until a macOS/auth owner explicitly chooses the Dashboard browser-auth contract.

recommendation.title: Use shared-token-only browser auth
recommendation.body: Land a rebased version of this PR after it updates all Dashboard injection paths, fixes the test helper, and proves the macOS behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced and recently maintained the native Dashboard window and endpoint-following auth path this decision affects.
